rows.text: In the bustling Interastral Department Store, a capsule machine coquettishly appears before you. Its dazzling lights, ear-shredding music, and countless shoe prints all over its surface are evident proof of its immense popularity.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Limited-edition Intelligentsia Guild collab capsules, surely worthy of your possession." Do people actually want this thing? You plant your face against the capsule machine, peering into its contents, to see if it carries merchandise of those familiar to you.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "How about it? Try your hand?" The capsule machine speaks out the thoughts in your head.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Consider it as helping out the Guild's business.
All right. You can count on two hands the number of scholars you know — there is simply no need to spend any cash on it.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Just ask yourself: Is this really not some Masked Fool's traps?
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The instant you learn to let go of the sunk cost is the instant you become smarter than half the Guild members in existence.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
